as_told.title: Bill Clinton's disclosure attempt and Webster Hubbell

plain: The story goes that in the 1990s President Bill Clinton and a close associate named Webster Hubbell tried to find out two things: who killed John F. Kennedy, and what is really going on with UFOs. A researcher named Steven Greer tells Michels that Hubbell admits this in a book of his own, though Greer does not recall its title. In Greer's words, Hubbell writes that "he and the president were trying to get to the bottom of a couple things," Kennedy's killing and UFOs. A journalist named Jeremy Corbell tells a shorter version that leaves out the book and Kennedy. He says Clinton "really tried" and that Hubbell was "crushed down" after asking. If true, it would mean even a sitting president had to send someone digging for answers on UFOs and could not get them.
